intro: Kot pravi pisni test: 45 minut, brez namigov. Najprej reši, kar znaš, potem se vrni k težjim nalogam. Sestavek naj ima 13–15 povedi: napiši ga na papir in ga na koncu primerjaj z vzorcem. Rešitve so na koncu.
source: v2: layout follows the Wider World 1 workbook exercise types in his photos (complete, choose, negatives, questions, find the mistake, True/False/Doesn't say reading) plus the teacher's writing task 'My family, 13–15 sentences'. No old test was available.

Napiši sestavek My family (13–15 povedi). Če želiš, lahko namesto tega opišeš svojega najboljšega prijatelja (My best friend). Napiši: koliko vas je, vsakega člana (ime, starost, od kod), videz (has got), kaj zna (can / can't), kaj radi jeste ali počnete in zaključek. Poveži z and in but. Na koncu preštej povedi in preveri pike, velike začetnice, has got, His/Her.
tasks.solution:
Točkovanje (12): vsebina 3 (vse zahtevano, 13–15 povedi), slovnica 4 (There are … in my family, has got, can, His/Her, glagol + s pri he/she), besedišče in črkovanje 3, povezovanje in pike 2.

Model: There are four people in my family: my mum, my dad, my brother and me. We've also got two cats. My mum's name is Daniela. She's from Mexico. She's kind and she can cook very well. My dad's name is Danijel. He's tall and he's got short dark hair. He can take great photos. My brother's name is Alan. He's got curly hair and brown eyes. He can ride his bike very well, but he can't swim. Our favourite food is pizza. At weekends we watch films together. I love my family very much.
